subject_line: An Author Spotlight for Caramels, Grudges, and Garden Gnomes
email_body:
Hi Morgana,

I noticed that Caramels, Grudges, and Garden Gnomes, the fifth Chocolate Shop Mystery, arrived in July, and I enjoyed the setup of chocolatier Narel Myers solving a murder in the quirky country town of Brambly Vale after a cup of her cocoa.

I would love to invite you to be featured in an Author Spotlight on The Author Ledger. The feature is designed to introduce readers to your work, the story behind your book, and the experiences or ideas that have shaped your journey as an author.

Alongside our editorial features, we also support authors with professionally produced audiobook editions, cinematic book trailers, short promotional reels, author websites, press kits, Amazon A+ graphics, and book relaunch materials.

One option that may suit the Chocolate Shop series is a short cinematic trailer and a few promotional reels for the new release. If that is something you have been considering, we can handle the full production. It is entirely optional.

The Author Spotlight is a paid feature, and I would be happy to share the details and pricing if it sounds like a good fit.

Would you be interested in hearing more about the feature and the option I believe would suit Caramels, Grudges, and Garden Gnomes best?

Warm regards,
Oseni Ibrahim
The Author Ledger
